A validate_collection_exists -> StorageError::not_found -> 404 mechanism exists in the codebase (collections_ops.rs:25-32) and is used by GET collection and alias creation, but the DELETE path never invokes it.

mundane_explanation.surviving: by_design: storage layer deliberately returns Ok(false)->HTTP 200 {result:false} for an absent collection (toc/collection_meta_ops.rs:272-284 with explanatory comment about the create-lock), the dispatcher performs no existence check for DeleteCollection, and the shipped OpenAPI template documents a single 200 response with result:boolean for this endpoint (openapi-collections.ytt.yaml:89-110 + openapi.lib.yml:1-35) — soft-delete semantics, not a missing validation. No 404-for-missing contract could be found in docs or source.
